title: **Exclude the
notes: offscreen Recharts text measurement helper from painted-text inspection.**
The sweep flagged the helper's small font as readable UI text.
result: The probe skips only the exact private measurement ID while its box is entirely above the viewport; visible content with the same ID remains inspected.
evidence: A real Chromium regression failed before the fix, then both offscreen and visible control cases passed: pnpm --filter @syntopica/ui-quality exec vitest run tests/capture/probe.measurement.integration.test.ts --maxWorkers=1. Upstream DOMUtils.ts confirms top -20000px placement (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/recharts/recharts/main/src/util/DOMUtils.ts). Independent review returned no findings.
